title: Racing in Jupiter with volumetric clouds
author: ActionLittle4176
selftext:
60fps version: [https://youtu.be/oSyY0u2kQAo](https://youtu.be/oSyY0u2kQAo)

I tried to create a track in the Jupiter's cloudy atmosphere, showcasing on a truly planetary scale. What do you think?

(three.js, opus 5.5, gpt gen 2, Tripo3D...)

comments.author: ygzok
comments.body: Looks fantastic imo. Bit unlucky the galactic racer being just released.

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body: Quite the opposite galactic racer builds the user base for him and helps to grow the niche for this kind of games. I suspect he will be in a different price range and could grab all the people that think galactic racer costs too much.

replies.author: ygzok
replies.body: I hope so. I am developing a racer myself and I hope we bring our niche back altogether. Kids nowadays don't enjoy what we did back in our day.

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body: Would be cool if it had weapons wich are maybe hard to aim and slow down the enemy down, similiar to Mario Kart where you only get them at limited supply by picking up boxes.

replies.author: ygzok
replies.body: Bro! Exactly what I am working on. I hope you'll like it. It is a comicbook style shooter arcade, with car gliding, nukes, weapons and stuff going on. I will post some videos here within a week.

comments.author: Comet7777
comments.body: This looks very good! Do you think the name might be a bit too close to Formula One?

comments.author: Individual-Quail-889
comments.body: oh yeah the polish looks real nice on this and gameplay looks fun

comments.author: Livid-Evidence579
comments.body: What happens if you go off the track and dive into the clouds of Jupiter

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body: Jupiter clouds are -166°F so better grap a warm coat.  Luckily when you go lower it will be around cozy  1,300°F. Somwhere down the core it will be hotter than the sun.

comments.author: No-Economics-6781
comments.body: F zero did it better. Slop.

comments.author: xoexohexox
comments.body: Hell yeah bringing back fond memories of f zero good job

comments.author: itsFauxProphete
comments.body: Awesome, my one concern with that genre is that are there enough players?  The original developers of Wip3out even had a hard time of making their new game Formula Fusion popular on Steam (which was renamed and relaunched and still failed).  I love antigrav racers, so I wish you luck, just seems like a saturated market or people are hard to keep interested.

comments.author: mrpoopistan
comments.body:
You're in first place very often by the first lap (see the screenshots), which suggests the AI driver model has had zero work over these months. All visuals and vibes, no racing.

This is my recurring complaint with every game I see on this sub: everything makes the game look too easy. The refund rate on this game is going to be atrocious because no one will need ten hours (where the refund limit kicks in) to take in this whole game.

comments.author: EldrichArchive
comments.body:
The look of your game is actually pretty cool, especially the sequence with the long jump where you have to aim for the track to land… brilliant idea. And the clouds look really amazing. But some of them still have artefacts like streaks and pixelated traces. Maybe you should run a blur filter over them again.

What strikes me, though, is that the gliders seem a bit ‘weightless’. When you touch down on the track, the glider shouldn’t just touch down without any feedback. It should hit the track with a real thud. That would make the glider feel much more tangible and ‘real’.

comments.author: johnesco
comments.body: Sir, can we talk about how many vehicles you hit?

comments.author: Neat-Ad-9550
comments.body:
It's a good looking game. I really like the background clouds and the upside down antigravity racing.

The problem is the other racers appear to be superfluous in this demo clip.
